new_primary_papers.title: Efficient Graph Generation with Graph Recurrent Attention Networks
new_primary_papers.scope: §§2.1–2.3, Eqs. (1)–(12); author source constructor loss lines190–203 and mixture_bernoulli_loss lines461–550 at commit70e0dd24bb357aeaacfcd585e77e4ebd0c55f8f8
new_primary_papers.verified_operation: Graph blocks are conditioned on previous graph structure through an attention GNN. Parallel factorial Bernoulli components are combined as a mixture to capture dependencies between block edges. The author routine sums per-edge BCE within component and then takes component logsumexp with component weights.
new_primary_papers.exact_ingredient_overlap: Proposed structural joint likelihood and responsibility gradients are inherited mixture-of-Bernoulli operations.
new_primary_papers.increment_not_verified_duplicate: Tying component likelihoods to the existing factorized NCNC recursive scorer/decoder; reconstruction of source observation incidence under native record masks; detached target completion and unchanged mean raw logits are not specified in the inspected GRAN method.
